Finishing crafting reagents enhance the crafting stats while making an item. These reagents don't modify the final product directly but instead improve the crafting process itself. They're essentially optional crafting reagents but provide benefit for crafting rather than the crafted item. The slot names cover a certain type of finishing reagent. This article lists the different types and their relevant items.
